seoTitle: Syed Raza Mumtaz | Network Architect & Technical Leader
seoDescription: Professional experience, technical leadership, education and certifications for Syed Raza Mumtaz, Principal Network Architect and Technical Leader.

hero.heading: Syed Raza Mumtaz
hero.introduction: Principal Network Architect and Technical Leader with more than 20 years of experience designing, validating and operating carrier-grade, cloud, data-center and mission-critical networks.

profile: Network architect and technical leader experienced in IP/MPLS, cloud, data-center, optical and low-latency networking across carrier, enterprise and mission-critical environments.
Combines deep engineering knowledge with presales leadership, customer advisory, solution design, technical validation and team mentorship.
Known for translating complex requirements into resilient, practical architectures and guiding customers and engineering teams from concept through delivery.
expertise: IP/MPLS, BGP, OSPF and traffic engineering
Ethernet, dark fibre, DWDM/CWDM and GPON/FTTx
High availability, resiliency and disaster recovery
Multi-vendor integration, PoCs, IVV&T and testing

experience.title: Manager, Sales Engineering (Wholesale)
summary: Lead solution architecture for a multi-country, multi-region enterprise network spanning more than 1,000 locations across the Caribbean and Latin America.
Direct strategic-account presales technical strategy and customer advocacy, aligning network solutions with business requirements and service objectives.
Build and mentor engineering teams while overseeing technical reporting, budgeting and product-improvement initiatives.

experience.title: Senior Sales Engineer (Wholesale)
summary: Designed regional and multinational connectivity solutions across wireless, terrestrial and subsea networks for carrier and enterprise customers.
Led technical RFP and RFI responses and advised customers on architectures aligned with their operational and business goals.

experience.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales
summary: Engineered dark-fibre, DWDM/CWDM, GPON, cloud and data-center connectivity solutions for high-capacity enterprise and carrier requirements.
Led RFP responses, technical presentations and implementation strategies while supporting sales, revenue assurance and cross-functional delivery.

experience.title: Managing Director
summary: Directed renovation and construction projects from design and procurement through implementation and handover.
Managed licensed trades, business development, cash flow and client relationships.

experience.title: Senior Engineer, Hybrid Cloud & Data Center Infrastructure
summary: Managed global advertising-exchange connectivity and hybrid-cloud and colocation operations for latency-sensitive real-time bidding platforms.
Optimized high-volume load balancing and network performance across distributed infrastructure.

experience.title: Senior Network Design Engineer
summary: Contributed network architecture and research-and-development work to Telesat's low-Earth-orbit satellite program.
Led control- and data-plane design using open-source SDN/NFV frameworks and created constellation simulators and R&D testbeds.
Delivered proof-of-concept designs, customer demonstrations, and network product and service definitions.

experience.title: Technical Operations Specialist, Private Cloud Engineering
summary: Managed multi-tenant cloud unified communications and Cisco data-center infrastructure, including Cisco Hosted Collaboration Solution environments.
Delivered UCaaS, UCCX and HCS Expressway proofs of concept for enterprise customers.

experience.title: Manager, Operations, Military SATCOM
summary: Provided technical and operational leadership for mission-critical military satellite communications supporting the UAE Armed Forces.
Led an 18-engineer, 24x7 Network Operations Center focused on service availability and incident resolution.
Directed automation, verification and validation, Tier-3 troubleshooting, and compliance with MILSATCOM and information-security standards.

experience.title: Bitstream Network Engineer / Tier-3 Internet Core
summary: Operated and optimized an IP/MPLS Internet backbone and GPON, FTTx and next-generation access networks.
Performed BGP and OSPF traffic engineering, vendor interoperability testing, capacity planning and disaster-recovery work.

experience.title: Network Analyst
summary: Designed low-latency, high-availability trading networks for financial institutions.
Strengthened resilience and redundancy for mission-critical financial-services operations.

certifications: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert - CCIE Service Provider #36259
MEF Carrier Ethernet Certified Professional - MEF-CECP
